# Version 4.153.0
> **Skia m153 engine update** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 updates the bundled renderer to Skia milestone m153. The update incorporates upstream correctness fixes. Linux applications that rely on fontconfig fallback should verify their text rendering after upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux font fallback can select a different face** — Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, which can change selected glyphs or text metrics. Specify an explicit family and style, or bundle the typeface, when deterministic font selection is required.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m153** — Updates the bundled rendering engine to the Chrome m153 line, including its upstream correctness fixes. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927), [#5062](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5062), [#5116](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5116))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300 scopes compiler conversion-warning suppressions to its native build, avoiding Windows binary-analysis warnings.
